title: Story premise ENT007: The Stubborn Confetti Cannon
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: This celebration is arriving one square at a time. Takeaway/theme: Small outputs can still make something worth celebrating.
description: A celebration planner wants one burst of confetti, but the hand-powered cannon only coughs out a single paper square each time. The planner arranges those squares into a giant celebratory mosaic; just as everyone applauds, the cannon releases a blank receipt labeled CONFETTI SOLD SEPARATELY.
